attributes.long_name: BIOMASS L2A forest height (FH), mean of the depth-12 cells observed
attributes.comment: Mapping by us: BIOMASS names this quantity 'forest height' (product FP_FH); we declare it as CF canopy_height. Products with median quality < 1.0 excluded (see fh_summary.json).
attributes.source: ESA BIOMASS L2A FP_FH, BPS-Biomass L2a processor 4.4.4, 200 m, via ESA MAAP
